# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified browser distribution from [kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator), pinned to commit `83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8`, file `js/dist/qrcode.js`.

License: MIT, reproduced in `qrcode.LICENSE`.

The file is served by this site. Pix payloads are encoded in the visitor's browser; no QR generation service receives the payment code.
